sources.title: SINUMERIK 840D sl/840D/840Di sl/840Di/810D Cycles Programming Manual
SINUMERIK 802D sl/840D/840D sl/840Di/840Di sl/810D Programming Manual ISO Milling (PGM)
sources.edition: 04.2007, 6FC5398-7BP10-0BA0; valid for 840D sl/DE sl SW 1.4 (828D not in validity list)

native_language_and_iso_mode.value: Siemens mode is default; G291 switches to ISO Dialect, G290 back, each in its own block.

program_open.value: No mandatory start block. Program name up to 24 chars (letters, digits, '_'; start with 2 letters or '_'+letter). Punch-tape files start with '%<name>_xxx', e.g. %_N_SHAFT123_MPF. Recommended milling header: T="name"/T<n>, M6, D1, G54 G17, G0 ... S.. M3 M8.

program_close.value: M2, M17 or M30 as last block (M2 = M30 for main program; M17 = end of subprogram).

comment.value: ';' to end of block. (Round brackets are not native comments.)

line_numbers.value: Optional: N + positive integer at start of block; any order, rising recommended; must be unique for searches.

block_end.value: LF (newline); block max 512 characters including comment and LF.

safe_start.value: G90 G94 G17 G71 (or G710) G40, D0 cancels tool offsets, G500 deselects settable ZO, MCALL (no name) cancels modal cycle call; S2 suggests CYCLE800() and TRAFOOF at program start when transforms may be active.
safe_start.note: No G49/G80 equivalents in native mode: length comp off = D0 (or T0); cycles are subprogram calls, modal only via MCALL.

tool_change.value: T<n> (or T="name") selects; M6 changes and activates tool + offset (milling); D<n> selects cutting-edge offset (D1 typical). On machines configured without M6 the T word changes directly. T range 0..32000.

tool_length_comp.value: Automatic: length offset of active D takes effect when D is programmed (applied on first move of the length axis); D0 cancels. Can be active without D if MD auto-edge activation is set.

spindle.value: S rpm with M3 CW / M4 CCW / M5 stop.

work_offset.value: G54..G57 (1st-4th), G505..G599 (5th-99th); 828D uses G58/G59 for 5th/6th instead of G505/G506. G500 deselect; G53/G153/SUPA suppress offsets non-modally.

arc_format.value: G2/G3 X Y Z with I J K (center, incremental from start by default; I=AC(..) for absolute) or CR= radius; G90/G91 only governs the end point.

rapid_linear.value: G0 rapid, G1 linear at F.

feed_word.value: F mm/min under G94 (also inch/min or deg/min); G95 mm/rev.

decimal_point.value: Value without a point is in whole units: manual example X90 -> X = 90 mm, Z-5 -> -5 mm, F500 -> 500 mm/min. Leading zeros and '+' optional.

max_digits.note: Not stated in S2 for axis words. M values INT 0..2147483647 (S2 13.1 p. 362); T and D 0..32000 (pp. 54, 73).

retract_home.value: G74 X1=0 Y1=0 Z1=0 (reference point approach, own block); G75 Z1=0 FP=<n> (fixed point from MD30600, e.g. tool change point); or G0 SUPA Z.. (machine coords, all offsets suppressed).

coolant_flood.value: M8 used for 'cooling on' in the manual's examples; not in the predefined M list, so machine-builder defined.

coolant_through_spindle.note: Not in S2; machine-builder M code.

coolant_off.value: M9 used for 'cooling off' in examples (machine-builder defined).

dwell.value: G4 F<s> (seconds) or G4 S<rev> (spindle revolutions), in its own block; F/S of the G4 block do not overwrite modal feed/speed.

drill_G81.value: CYCLE81(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR): RTP retract plane abs, RFP reference plane abs, SDIS clearance (unsigned), DP final depth abs or DPR depth relative to RFP (unsigned). Feed/speed from preceding blocks.

dwell_drill_G82.value: CYCLE82(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, DTB); DTB dwell at final depth in seconds.

peck_G83.value: CYCLE83(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, FDEP, FDPR, DAM, DTB, DTS, FRF, VARI, _AXN, _MDEP, _VRT, _DTD, _DIS1); VARI=1 chip removal (full retract), VARI=0 chip breaking; FDEP/FDPR first depth, DAM degression.

chip_break_G73.value: CYCLE83 with VARI=0 (chip breaking), _VRT retract amount (0 = 1 mm).

rigid_tap_G84.value: CYCLE84(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, DTB, SDAC, MPIT, PIT, POSS, SST, SST1, _AXN, _PTAB, _TECHNO, _VARI, _DAM, _VRT): pitch given as MPIT (metric size 3..48) or PIT (pitch value, sign = hand); SST tapping speed, SST1 retract speed; SDAC spindle direction after cycle (3/4/5). No F word for the tap: pitch + speed define it. Needs position-controlled spindle. Floating holder: CYCLE840 (S3 2.1.7 p. 63).

bore_ream_G85.value: CYCLE85(RTP, RFP, SDIS, DP, DPR, DTB, FFR, RFF): FFR feed in, RFF retract feed.

return_level_G98_G99.value: No G98/G99: retraction is to RTP given in each cycle call.

cycle_cancel_G80.value: Cycles are one-shot subprogram calls; modal repetition only with 'MCALL CYCLE8x(...)'; 'MCALL' alone cancels.

peck_depth_word.value: FDEP (abs) / FDPR (relative) first depth + DAM degression (CYCLE83 parameters, positional).

cycle_dwell_units.value: DTB in seconds (CYCLE82, CYCLE84); in CYCLE83 DTB/DTS/_DTD >0 = seconds, <0 = revolutions.

notes: Cycle manual S3 is the 11/2006 edition (cycles 7.3). Current SINUMERIK Operate cycles take more parameters (memory says, unverified); positional parameters may be omitted with empty commas. S2 is 2013 (SW 4.5 SP2).
